manifest.description: Rewrite `Provider<Big>.get().<getter>()` call chains across a Java file into typed-provider equivalents, driven by an operator-supplied {getter → newProviderField} mapping. v1 ships call-site rewrites only.
when_to_use: after splitting a Provider<Big> injection on the enclosing class — drag callers from `provider.get().getX()` to `xProvider.get()`
part of the god-bean unbundling sequence: split the injection, migrate callers, then prune the old provider field
anti_patterns: do not use to add the typed-provider @Inject fields — v1 doesn't auto-inject; operator must add new fields first (or wait for v2 with shared DI helper)
do not use for non-Provider injections — this primitive matches the `<field>.get().<getter>()` chain shape specifically

getter_mapping.description: {old getter name → new provider field name}. At least one entry required.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-split-provider. Charter: After splitting a Provider<Big> injection on the enclosing class, rewrite callers from `<old>.get().<getter>()` to `<newProvider>.get()`.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Verify the new typed-provider fields exist on the enclosing class:
   bbox_code_symbols on each value in getter_mapping. If any are missing, refuse and ask the operator to add the @Inject Provider<NewType> fields first.

3. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_split_provider",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      delegate_field="{{delegate_field}}",
                      toml_entries={ getter_mapping: {{getter_mapping}} },
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")

4. Apply and compile-verify.

5. Emit done note with call_sites_rewritten count.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{delegate_field}} {{getter_mapping}} {{impl_name}}
